ext.title: Browser extension
ext.lead: A button and a right-click item in Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers send the video to To Picture. If a site needs sign-in, the extension passes your sign-in along with the link.
ext.s1: Open the extensions page — copy the address and paste it into the address bar:
ext.s1sub: Brave, Vivaldi, Yandex Browser and Opera work the same way.
ext.s2: Turn on “Developer mode” (top right in Chrome, bottom left in Edge).
ext.s3: Click “Load unpacked” and choose this folder:
ext.foot: The browser doesn’t let apps install extensions silently, so this is done once by hand. The extension updates together with To Picture.
ext.notLinkedHint: click “Connect” so the browser can reach the app
ext.queued: The link from the browser is added to the list — it will download in the next run.
py.browserLogin: The site needs sign-in — trying with your sign-in from the browser…
